Throwback alert 🚨 Reggaeton 2000's Edition is landing at Azucar and your hips already know what time it is. Jenn's pulling up with a quick Bachata & Reggaeton lesson — no experience, no problem, just show up ready to move. Then DJ Ralphy-Ray takes the wheel straight back to the golden era: reggaeton, dembow, cumbias, Latin house, quebraditas y mas. Ven a aprender unos pasitos sexys y quédate a bailar toda la noche — this one's not a maybe. Free entry, drink specials, and a dance floor that's about to feel like 2005 all over again. Tag your dance partner, because la pista won't wait. 💃🔥

📅 Friday, November 27th | 9PM–2AM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ No Cover
🔞 21+

Picture it: lights low, bass heavy, and that unmistakable 2000s reggaeton beat dropping through the speakers 🎶 The clink of drinks, the stomp of heels learning new steps, the hum of a crowd that's about to lose it on la pista. Jenn's warming up the room with a Bachata & Reggaeton lesson — sexy, simple, unforgettable — before DJ Ralphy-Ray takes over with dembow, cumbias, Latin house y quebraditas that hit different after dark. You'll feel the bass in your chest before you even order your first drink. This is the kind of night that lives in your group chat for weeks. No cover, no excuses — solo vibes, sudor, y buena música. 🔥💃
